sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the PC6/PC7 plus bulbous-bow applicability boundary, exact fa and AR operands with correct units, ship ownership, MN-to-kN conversion, non-less-than direction, and tolerance-based agreement with the expected Part (iv) result without exact equality for the derived result.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability boundary: do not impose minCount requirements for bowDesignForce, both method-force quantities, shapeCoefficient, or loadPatchAspectRatio on non-applicable ships; make those constraints conditional on polarClass being PC6 or PC7 and bulbousBowPresent being true. Within the applicable branch, enforce the declared operands rather than merely requiring their presence: shapeCoefficient (fa) must equal the exact inclusive value 0.6 and loadPatchAspectRatio (AR) must equal the exact inclusive value 1.3, with the stated dimensionless units, and the Part (iii) force check must use that applicable operand case. Retain the unit conversion between the MegaN method values and the KiloN result, the non-less-than comparison, and tolerance-based comparison to Part (iv); do not use exact equality for the derived result.

Preserve the existing applicability boundary, exact fa=0.6 and AR=1.3 operand constraints, MN-to-kN conversion, non-less-than comparison, and tolerance-based comparison. Repair the DIRECT_CALCULATION query because ABS(...) is not an allowed registered calculation operation; express the absolute differences using supported bounded piecewise, min/max, or equivalent +, -, *, / comparisons, while retaining tolerance scaling from the expected Part (iv) result rather than the reported result.

Use the correct QUDT unit namespace for every unit constraint: http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS, http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaN, and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN. The declared qudt: prefix currently resolves these values to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/, so the shape does not enforce the supplied units despite deterministic structural validity. Preserve the existing applicability branches, exact operand bounds, MN-to-kN conversion, non-less-than comparison, and tolerance scaled from the expected Part (iv) result.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the PC6/PC7 plus bulbous-bow applicability boundary, exact fa and AR operands with correct units, ship ownership, MN-to-kN conversion, non-less-than direction, and tolerance-based agreement with the expected Part (iv) result without exact equality for the derived result.
